title: Optimal and Efficient Online Inverse Optimization
abstract: In online inverse linear optimization, a learner recommends an action and then observes the choice of an expert who maximizes a fixed, unknown linear objective on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$; the goal is to learn to optimize this objective without observing it. Sakaue recently obtained the optimal regret $O(\sqrt d)$ with a randomized algorithm making $(dT)^{O(d)}$ linear optimizations per round, and asked whether it can be attained in polynomial time. We answer positively: our deterministic algorithm has regret $O(\sqrt d)$ for every horizon $T$ and runs in time polynomial in $d$ and $T$. It is a variant of the variable-metric algorithms of Sakaue et al.\ and Cai et al., in which a metric update is revoked once the query point moves far enough from where the update was made.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a graduate course on Online Learning and Inverse Optimization, today’s lecture is on Optimal and Efficient Online Inverse Optimization. Recent work such as “Efficient Online Inverse Optimization with O(d) Regret” and “Tight Regret Bound for Online Inverse Linear Optimization via Multiscale Matrix Weights” reflects a push toward lower regret and more efficient algorithms. This paper, by researchers at Google Research, including collaborators affiliated with NYU and Carnegie Mellon, asks whether optimal regret can also be deterministic and proper. I see Noah’s hand; go ahead.
segments.zh: 在一门关于在线学习与逆优化的研究生课程中，今天的讲座主题是最优且高效的在线逆优化。近期的一些工作，比如《以O(d)遗憾实现高效在线逆优化》和《通过多尺度矩阵权重为在线逆线性优化给出紧遗憾界》，反映出大家正在推动更低的遗憾和更高效的算法。这篇论文由Google Research的研究人员撰写，其中包括与NYU和卡内基梅隆大学有关联的合作者，它问的是：最优遗憾是否也可以同时是确定性的和proper的。我看到Noah举手了，请讲。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, what does inverse optimization mean in this setting?
segments.zh: 教授您好，在这个设定下，逆优化是什么意思？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The learner sees an expert choose an action from a changing set of options, but does not see the expert’s objective or the values assigned to the options. The learner must infer enough about the expert’s preferences to recommend well next time. Regret measures the cumulative shortfall of those recommendations under the hidden objective. The challenge is to keep that shortfall small even when the available action sets are chosen adversarially.
segments.zh: 学习者看到专家在一组不断变化的选项里选了一个动作，但看不到专家的目标，也看不到各个选项被赋予的价值。学习者必须推断出足够多的关于专家偏好的信息，才能在下次给出好的推荐。遗憾值衡量的是这些推荐在隐藏目标下的累计差距。难点在于，即使可用的动作集是被对抗性地挑选出来的，也要让这个差距保持很小。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the learner watches choices rather than rewards?
segments.zh: 所以学习者看到的是选择，而不是奖励？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The paper formalizes the expert’s preference as a fixed hidden vector, while each round brings a new action set. The expert selects the action that scores highest under that vector; the learner observes the selected action, but not the scores. Earlier methods achieved regret growing with the number of rounds. Later work made regret independent of the horizon or logarithmic in it, but the best guarantees came with tradeoffs in dimension dependence, randomization, or computational cost.
segments.zh: 没错。这篇论文把专家的偏好形式化为一个固定的隐藏向量，而每一轮都会带来新的动作集。专家选择在该向量下得分最高的动作；学习器能观察到被选中的动作，但看不到得分。早期方法的遗憾会随轮数增长。后来的工作让遗憾不再依赖于轮数，或者只随轮数对数增长，但最好的保证往往要在维度依赖、随机化或计算成本上做出取舍。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central result closes an important part of that gap. The authors give a deterministic, proper learner with regret proportional to the square root of the dimension, for every horizon. Proper means the learner maintains an explicit estimate of the expert’s objective and recommends an action that maximizes that estimate over the current options. The dimension dependence is optimal up to constants, matching known lower bounds rather than merely improving on earlier algorithms.
segments.zh: 这个核心结果填补了其中一大块空白。作者提出了一个确定性的、proper 的学习器，其遗憾与维度的平方根成正比，且对任意时间跨度都成立。所谓 proper，是指学习器维护对专家目标的显式估计，并在当前可选动作中推荐使该估计最大化的动作。这种维度依赖在常数因子内是最优的，与已知下界相匹配，而不只是对早期算法的改进。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: why is being proper important?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：为什么保持“恰当”这一点很重要？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A proper learner’s recommendation follows from a concrete objective estimate, so its behavior has a direct interpretation as a model of the expert’s preferences. That can matter in applications where we want to inspect or use the inferred objective, not just obtain a good action. The paper also shows that optimal regret does not require abandoning this structure. Its proof first transforms inverse optimization into a more general problem called a cutting-plane game.
segments.zh: 一个规范的学习器给出的推荐，源自一个具体的、对目标的估计，所以它的行为可以直接解释为对专家偏好的建模。在我们想要检查或使用推断出的目标、而不只是得到一个好动作的应用里，这一点很重要。论文还表明，实现最优遗憾并不需要放弃这种结构。它的证明首先把逆优化转化成一个更一般的问题，叫做切平面博弈。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In that game, the learner queries a point that represents its current estimate. An oracle replies with a direction that separates the query from the hidden point, while respecting a strong separation condition. The learner’s loss is tied to how far its query lies from the hidden point in that direction. A reduction then turns a learner for this game into a proper inverse-optimization algorithm, with at most a factor-of-2 increase in regret.
segments.zh: 在这个博弈中，学习器查询一个代表其当前估计的点。预言机回复一个方向，把查询点与隐藏点分开，同时满足一个强分离条件。学习器的损失取决于其查询点在该方向上离隐藏点有多远。随后通过一个归约，把该博弈的学习器转化为一个恰当逆优化算法，遗憾最多增加两倍。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify what makes the new algorithm different from earlier variable-metric methods?
segments.zh: 你能说清楚这个新算法和早期的变度量方法到底有什么不同吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Earlier variable-metric approaches accumulated information in a matrix that permanently changed how the learner moved. RVM, the paper’s main algorithm, allows some of those metric updates—called stretches—to be revoked. Intuitively, a stretch slows movement along a direction the learner has already explored. If the query later travels far enough, that stretch can be removed, restoring flexibility instead of letting old information constrain every future step.
segments.zh: 早期的变度量方法会把信息累积在一个矩阵里，这个矩阵会永久性地改变学习器的移动方式。而RVM——也就是这篇论文提出的主要算法——允许其中一些度量更新被撤销，这些更新被称为“拉伸”。直观地说，一个拉伸会减慢学习器沿着已经探索过的方向移动。如果查询之后移动得足够远，这个拉伸就可以被移除，从而恢复灵活性，而不是让旧信息约束未来的每一步。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That revocation is the first key insight: the algorithm can use stronger temporary updates without paying for them forever. The second is a geometric rule for deciding when to revoke one. Each stretch is active only while the query remains inside a slab around where the stretch began; reaching a boundary triggers its removal. The slab is sized so the query has moved enough that the refund from revocation can cover the update’s earlier cost.
segments.zh: 这种撤销机制是第一个关键洞见：算法可以采用更强的临时更新，而不必永远为它们付出代价。第二个关键洞见是一条几何规则，用来决定何时撤销某个拉伸。每个拉伸只在查询仍处于其起始位置附近的板层内时保持活跃；一旦到达边界，就会触发撤销。板层的大小经过设定，使得查询已经移动了足够远，撤销带来的返还足以覆盖该更新此前的成本。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Wait, how does the analysis keep track of those costs?
segments.zh: 等等，这个分析是怎么追踪这些成本的？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The proof tracks the squared distance from the query to the hidden point, measured using the current metric. Creating a stretch increases this potential, while revoking it gives back part of that cost. Stretches that remain active are handled with a separate trace-based potential involving the inverse metric. Together, these accounting tools control movement, the lifetime of each stretch, and the updates that survive. The resulting cutting-plane regret is at most 6.375 times the radius times the square root of the dimension.
segments.zh: 证明过程追踪的是查询点到隐藏点之间、用当前度量衡量的平方距离。创建一段延伸会增大这个势能，而撤销它则能收回其中一部分代价。仍然活跃的延伸则用另一个基于迹的势能来处理，其中涉及逆度量。这些记账工具合在一起，控制了移动、每段延伸的存活时间，以及最终保留下来的更新。由此得到的切割平面遗憾上界，最多是半径乘以维度平方根的6.375倍。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The reduction gives inverse-optimization regret below 13 times the square root of the dimension, uniformly over the horizon and adaptive action sets. In each round, the learner also solves one linear optimization problem over the current action set. The stated arithmetic cost grows with the round number, though it remains polynomial for finite horizons. A variant skips sufficiently small stretches: it improves average computation while retaining essentially the same regret guarantee.
segments.zh: 这个归约给出的逆优化遗憾小于13倍维度平方根，并且在整个时间跨度和自适应动作集上都是一致的。每一轮中，学习器还要在当前动作集上解一个线性优化问题。所述的算术开销随轮数增长，不过在有限时间跨度内仍然是多项式的。有一个变体跳过了足够小的拉伸：它改善了平均计算量，同时基本保持了相同的遗憾保证。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does that mean the algorithm is efficient in practice as well as in theory?
segments.zh: 这是否意味着该算法不仅在理论上高效，在实践中也同样高效？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper establishes polynomial computation, not practical performance on real applications; it reports no empirical evaluation. The basic algorithm’s per-round arithmetic cost increases over time. The skipping variant reduces the average cost to a bound that grows logarithmically with the horizon, but it does not eliminate horizon dependence. A finite-precision version also makes the guarantees robust to rounding, at the cost of a larger constant in the regret bound.
segments.zh: 这篇论文证明的是多项式时间计算，而不是在实际应用中的表现；它没有报告任何实证评估。基础算法的每轮算术开销会随时间增长。跳步变体把平均开销降到一个随轮数对数增长的界，但并没有消除对轮数的依赖。有限精度版本还让理论保证对舍入误差更稳健，代价是遗憾界里的常数变大。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader shift is that optimal dimension dependence can coexist with deterministic, proper recommendations. Earlier work, including “Efficient Online Inverse Optimization with O(d) Regret,” offered deterministic proper learning but with a larger dependence on dimension. Randomized and improper approaches reached the square-root rate, but with substantial implementation costs. RVM shows that revocable updates can bridge those approaches’ tradeoffs, at least for regret and polynomial-time computation.
segments.zh: 更广泛的转变在于，最优的维度依赖可以与确定性的、合规的推荐共存。早期工作，包括“Efficient Online Inverse Optimization with O(d) Regret”，提供了确定性的合规学习，但对维度的依赖更大。随机化和不合规的方法达到了平方根速率，但实现成本很高。RVM表明，可撤销更新可以弥合这些方法之间的权衡，至少在遗憾和多项式时间计算方面是如此。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What remains open after this result?
segments.zh: 这个结果之后还有哪些问题没有解决？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The key open question is whether one can retain square-root-of-dimension regret while making per-round computation polynomial in dimension and independent of the round number. The work also points toward applications where decisions reveal preferences, such as contextual recommendation, routing, and control. But theoretical regret alone does not establish usefulness in those domains; empirical testing and attention to modeling assumptions would be needed. The authors also report that an automated system helped produce the proof, which they verified and edited.
segments.zh: 关键的开放问题是，能否在保持维度平方根级遗憾的同时，让每轮计算量在维度上呈多项式增长，并且与轮数无关。这项工作还指向了一些决策会揭示偏好的应用场景，比如上下文推荐、路径规划和控制。但仅有理论上的遗憾保证，并不能证明它在这些领域就有用；还需要做实证测试，并关注建模假设是否成立。作者还提到，一个自动化系统帮助生成了证明，他们随后对其进行了验证和编辑。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The main takeaway is a useful algorithmic principle: information need not remain in a learner’s model forever. By letting metric updates be revoked when their job is done, this paper reaches optimal dimension-dependent regret while preserving a clear objective estimate and deterministic behavior. That is a meaningful theoretical advance, alongside an honest reminder that computational guarantees and practical performance are different questions. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 核心结论是一条有用的算法原则：信息不必永远留在学习器的模型里。通过让度量更新在完成任务后被撤销，这篇论文在保持清晰的目标估计和确定性行为的同时，达到了依赖维度的最优遗憾界。这是一个有意义的理论进展，同时也诚实地提醒我们，计算保证和实际表现是两回事。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
